exclusions.run-properties: Edited paragraphs, and mark-only rebuilds whose runs no longer map exactly to the normalized text, retain paragraph and first-run properties; other run formatting and rebuilt hyperlinks have no text-only mapping. Follow-up #874.
exclusions.fields: Rebuilt computed fields become their displayed text under ADR 0086/S64, with no update instruction. Follow-up #874.
exclusions.hyperlinks: Rebuilt paragraphs retain hyperlink text but lose clickable wrappers. Follow-up #874.
exclusions.unrepresented-revisions: Original formatting revisions and other revisions AI7 did not import as marks are not written: their revision markup is dropped, the run keeps its current formatting and the text keeps the rejected reading the import took (ADR 0086/S64). Follow-up #874.
